campaigns.title: The Day Starts When You Decide It Does
campaigns.audience: Well-travelled HNW couples, 40–60, UK & DACH markets
campaigns.hero_line: The day starts when you decide it does.
campaigns.body: A swim before the island wakes. Bread still warm. The sea, unhurried. Lyrá.
campaigns.outcome: Launch season sold out 11 weeks ahead; 0% paid-media discounting. Featured in Condé Nast Traveller 'Quietest Openings of the Year'.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Sold the feeling of time and subtraction, not the property. No price, no urgency, no superlatives.

campaigns.title: Out of Season
campaigns.hero_line: The island, with the volume turned down.
campaigns.body: October light is longer. The cellar is fuller. The sea is yours. We keep a few rooms for those who prefer the quiet months.
campaigns.outcome: 41% open rate, 9% direct-booking conversion, extended shoulder season by 6 weeks.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Reframed off-season as a privilege, not a discount. Stayed on-voice: calm, sensory, no offer language.

campaigns.title: Stone & Cellar
campaigns.hero_line: Dinner is at the table the island built.
campaigns.body: One long table, cut from local stone. Wines from the cliffside cellar. No menu printed — the kitchen decides with the morning catch.
campaigns.outcome: Sold out all 8 dinners; 60% of attendees rebooked a future stay on the spot.
campaigns.why_it_worked: Specificity = luxury. The stone table and unprinted menu did the work that 'world-class dining' never could.
